message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here is the **complete text** visible on screen. 

**Note:** This screenshot shows a **configuration UI dialog** (for setting up a custom connected app in Google Gemini), **not a terminal build log or deploy log**. There is no terminal output, command-line text, or build process logs visible in this image. The only status/error message is the validation error shown below.

---

### Complete Text from Screenshot

**Header:**
```
Set up a custom connected app
```

**Form Fields & Labels:**
```
Add a custom app link

https://my-mcp-server-8l8g.onrender.com/sse

The MCP server could not be reached. Check the URL.

Advanced settings

Client ID
OAuth client ID

Client secret
OAuth client secret
```

**Actions:**
```
Copy redirect URI
```

**Informational Text:**
```
About custom connected apps

By adding this link, you're allowing Gemini to send info to a custom 
connected app that hasn't been reviewed by Google. Make sure that you 
trust this service before connecting. Learn more about connecting custom 
apps
```

**Buttons:**
```
Cancel    Next
```

---

### Status/Error Message (The only "log-like" output):
```
The MCP server could not be reached. Check the URL.
```

**Context:** This red error message indicates that the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server endpoint at `https://my-mcp-server-8l8g.onrender.com/sse` is either not running, not responding, or returning an error when Gemini attempts to connect to it via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

If you are looking for the actual **Render deploy/build logs** for this service, you would need to navigate to your Render dashboard → select the `my-mcp-server-8l8g` service → click the **"Logs"** tab (not this Gemini configuration screen).
